purpose: Teach: アンダー/ハリケーン/レバー/セクハラ/ワープロ/メトロ/合気道/ダイヤル

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、新メニューにアンダーパスタって書いて、と言ってたよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, a customer was asking us to add 'Under Pasta' to the new menu.
lines.style: Soft observation, as if remembering something that just occurred to her. Gentle, conversational tone. Slight pause before the detail, like she's making sure it's worth mentioning.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、ハリケーンのニュース見たわ、メイちゃん
lines.en: Did you see the news about the hurricane?
lines.style: Quiet shift in topic, almost hesitant. Eyes still on the task at hand. The kind of worry that surfaces while doing something else. Warm but distracted.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、ビールのレバーを引いてサーバーチェック、メイちゃん
lines.en: The beer lever needs checking on the server again.
lines.style: Matter-of-fact, moving through the checklist. No drama — just noticing what needs doing. Practical efficiency with a note of quiet care underneath.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お店ではセクハラ対策、徹底しようね、メイちゃん
lines.en: Let's make sure we're keeping the shop safe — no room for that kind of behavior.
lines.style: Steady, measured firmness. Not lecturing. The voice of someone who has thought this through. Direct eye contact implied. Resolute but not angry.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お祖父ちゃんはワープロをずっと使ってらしたわよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: Grandpa used to swear by his word processor. Wouldn't switch to anything else.
lines.style: Nostalgic, slightly amused. The cadence of remembering someone. Soft fondness in the delivery. A small smile in the voice.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、メトロ駅から歩いて来てくださるね、メイちゃん
lines.en: The customers really do come all the way from the Metro station, don't they.
lines.style: Observation with a note of appreciation. Light, almost charmed. The rhythm of noticing something small and genuine about the place.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、合気道のお客様、お洒落な所作だね、メイちゃん
lines.en: That aikido student has such elegant movements, doesn't he.
lines.style: Genuine admiration, clearly stated but not overdone. Slight warmth. The ease of noticing and naming something good without self-consciousness.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お電話のダイヤル番号、お間違いなく、メイちゃん
lines.en: Double-check that phone number before you dial it.
lines.style: Quick, direct instruction — caring underneath. The tone of someone looking out for you. Brief, clear, no edge to it.
